video_title: 2026-27 Training Camp Media Availability 🎙️ | Tyrese Maxey

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey organized team workouts and social gatherings to build chemistry with new teammates.
quotes.quote: I just wanted to get guys in the gym. I think that's the easiest way to kind of get to know guys. Especially because it's kind of awkward, you know? They come from different teams, come from different places. You don't talk to them if you never talked to them before. Maybe you see them or you compete with them but you never had real conversation with them. After everybody, we have the same language, basketball. You get on the court, get a workout in, after the workout now you're talking, you're laughing. And he came over to my house, ate, met my daughter, all that stuff. So it's like, that's kind of what I just did, trying to just bring guys together as much as I possibly can.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says he focused on getting new teammates together in the gym and at his house to build chemistry, saying, I just wanted to get guys in the gym. I think that's the easiest way to kind of get to know guys.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey praises Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's early training camp performance and his potential impact on Justin Edwards.
quotes.excerpt: He's been fantastic the past two days, honestly. He's in shape, he's picking up the ball.
quotes.quote: He's been fantastic the past two days, honestly. He's in shape, he's picking up the ball, he's shooting the ball really well. I think he's going to be a great addition for us. I also think he's going to be great for guys like Justin. That's a two-time champion that Justin can look at and see, kind of in the same role, you know, a little bit. But a wing defender, shooter, Justin can score a little bit too, so I think that's a good bet for us and a good bet for him to look at.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey is impressed with Kentavious Caldwell-Pope at training camp, saying he has been fantastic, is in great shape, and will be a great addition for the team.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey says his primary goal this season is winning rather than individual statistical performance.
quotes.excerpt: I want to be judged by winning. We win, that's what I want to be judged by.
quotes.quote: I'm at the point now where I showed I can do talent-wise, I think. Of course I'm continue to get better, but I want to be judged by winning. We win, that's what I want to be judged by. So that's really my main mindset, my main goal is finding ways to win. And then I feel like because of, like you said, I play so many different roles, I'm capable of doing so many different things. And that's going to be a positive for myself and for the team. I can play on the ball, play off the ball, I can play in transition, I can catch and shoot, off pin downs, I can play pick and roll.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says he is no longer focused on individual talent, but rather on team success, stating, I want to be judged by winning. We win, that's what I want to be judged by.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey explains how having multiple ball handlers creates more versatility and scoring opportunities for the team.
quotes.excerpt: It unlocks everything. It unlocks like me being a catch and shoot guy.
quotes.quote: It unlocks everything. It unlocks like me being a catch and shoot guy. I feel like I'm a pretty good catch and shoot guy. Anthony Simons been a catch and shoot guy. He doesn't have to be on the ball to get shots. He can create a shot off the dribble but if Jaylen Brown is getting to the paint and the teams are collapsing, kick out to Ant for a wide open three. I think LeBron, he can play off cuts, he doesn't have to always be on the ball. Joel doesn't have to always be in the post or whatever, he can roam. Me, I don't have to play on the ball every single possession. I can do a lot of different things.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey explains how having multiple playmakers on the floor creates more scoring opportunities for everyone, saying, It unlocks everything. It unlocks like me being a catch and shoot guy.
